The topology expert's mask confidence (0.8055) is moderate, suggesting some boundary ambiguity, likely due to the cloth blending with the altar edges. The geometric depth auditor found no gross grounding failures, which is good. The perceptual quality auditor found no noise/compression, which is also good. Overall, the artifacts are primarily in the fine details and background complexity, not the main subject's structure.
